name: ComputeFirst
description: Search a catalog of versioned, deterministic tools for exact arithmetic, CSV and JSON transforms, ISO 8601 date math, text, hashing, identifier check digits and unit conversions, read a tool's input schema and limits, then execute it by id and version (one call or a batch of up to 20). Anonymous access with no API key; optional account tools (sign-in, saved tools, activity) are also exposed.
